description: This Java source file defines utility methods for creating and managing Netty network components within Apache Spark, including event loop groups, channel classes, and buffer allocators, with support for different I/O modes such as NIO, EPOLL, and KQUEUE.

classes.name: NettyUtils
classes.description: Utility class for creating and managing Netty network components based on I/O mode.

methods.name: freeDirectMemory
methods.description: Returns the amount of free direct memory available.

methods.name: createThreadFactory
methods.description: Creates a ThreadFactory with a specified thread name prefix.

methods.name: createEventLoop
methods.description: Creates a Netty EventLoopGroup based on the specified I/O mode and thread count.

methods.name: getClientChannelClass
methods.description: Returns the appropriate client SocketChannel class for the given I/O mode.

methods.name: getServerChannelClass
methods.description: Returns the appropriate server SocketChannel class for the given I/O mode.

methods.name: createFrameDecoder
methods.description: Creates a LengthFieldBasedFrameDecoder with an 8-byte length field.

methods.name: getRemoteAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the remote address of a channel or returns '<unknown remote>'.

methods.name: defaultNumThreads
methods.description: Calculates the default number of Netty threads based on available cores.

methods.name: getSharedPooledByteBufAllocator
methods.description: Lazily creates and returns a shared pooled ByteBuf allocator based on cache allowance.

methods.name: createPooledByteBufAllocator
methods.description: Creates a pooled ByteBuf allocator with specified direct buffer and cache settings.

methods.name: preferDirectBufs
methods.description: Determines if direct ByteBufs are preferred based on configuration and platform support.
